description: Create a draft or scheduled post. Pass is_draft=true to save as draft (no schedule). Otherwise set scheduledFor (ISO 8601 UTC) to schedule. Use libraryItemId for single media or mediaIds for carousels (max 10). Pinterest posts need a board per targeted account (list_pinterest_boards → platformMetadata.pinterest.boardIdByAccount); Reddit posts need platformMetadata.reddit.subreddit.

is_draft.description: Convenience: true sets status='draft'. False (and with scheduledFor) sets status='scheduled'.

platformAccountIds.description: Per-platform account targeting for multi-account platforms, e.g. {"twitter": ["<accountId>"]} from list_social_accounts. Omit to use all connected accounts.

platformMetadata.description: Per-platform settings. Pinterest posts need pinterest.boardIdByAccount and Reddit posts need reddit.subreddit before they can publish; drafts save without them.

boardIdByAccount.description: Pinterest account id (from list_social_accounts) → board id (from list_pinterest_boards). One entry per targeted Pinterest account.

status.description: Explicit status. Overrides is_draft if both passed.

title.description: Internal label (1–140 chars) shown in the dashboard list; not published. Auto-derived from caption if omitted.

name: create_post
title: Create post
